neo-med-1005.name: PENTHORUM
neo-med-1005.description: PENTHORUM SEDOIDES Virginia Stonecrop (PENTHORUM) A remedy for coryza, with rawness and wet feeling in nose. Throat feels raw. Chronic disorders of mucous membranes, with irritability. Chronic post-nasal catarrh; chronic pharyngitis, mucous membrane purple and relaxed. Posterior nares feel moist and raw; nose and ears feel full. Aphonia, hoarseness, relaxed vocal cords. Hypersecretion of mucous membranes. Itching of anus and burning in rectum. Trouble in pharyngeal vault and Eustachian tube. This remedy is well-indicated when the characteristic symptoms match the patient's presentation. Key modalities and concomitants guide the prescription.
